set.body: Complete the compatibility and removal ledger, dependency audit, docs, examples, benchmarks, and repository-wide verification. Remove a wrapper only after all repository consumers use the shared source of truth. Acceptance follows phase 11 and section 14 of docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md: no duplicate generic calculus remains, module docs and build aliases agree, performance receipts exist, warnings are clean, and compileAll plus testAll pass on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Locus 11: remove compatibility duplicates and pass release gates
